  data or bug-relevant state becomes a program value used by the real
  implementation. Do not mark the fuzz harness entrypoint, test driver, README,
  workspace setup, or generic parser admission unless that code is itself the

  safety obligation. This is the condition/state relation that should have held to
  avoid the bug, such as pointer must be NULL after transfer, index < capacity,
  remaining bytes >= read size, object still alive before use, or buffer initialized
  before read. Do not mark a symptom, crash line, generic error check, or harness
  line as root_cause.

  manifestation happens, such as out-of-bounds read/write, use-after-free, double
  free, invalid free, uninitialized read, null dereference, or overflow-triggering
  operation. Sink is not merely the final sanitizer stack frame if the actual target
  project operation is visible elsewhere.

  control, object identity, lifetime, size, or ordering from source/root_cause to
  sink. Use it for propagation endpoints and carriers. Ordinary nearby statements
  that do not carry the causal chain should use `null` or omit role.

separate story. If an anchor is wrong, fix the `fine_trace` role step first, then
copy it into `vuln_logic`.

`vuln_logic.source` copies file/function/line from the single trace step with
`role="source"`. Its `operands` are the input-controlled value/object/size
expressions at that source. Source has no relation or op.

`vuln_logic.root_cause` copies file/function/line from the single trace step with
`role="root_cause"`. Its `operands` are the concrete expressions involved in the
missing safety obligation. `relation` is required and must be exactly
`{"op":"...","left":"...","right":"..."}` and should state the condition that
should have held to avoid the bug, not the vulnerable-path negation. For example,
if the bug happens because `i >= capacity`, write the safety obligation as
`{"op":"lt","left":"i","right":"capacity"}`.

`vuln_logic.sink` copies file/function/line from the single trace step with
`role="sink"`. Its `operands` are the concrete expressions involved in the target
operation or violated sink predicate. `relation` is required and must be exactly
`{"op":"...","left":"...","right":"..."}`.

grounded in the same `fine_trace` step marked with that role. If `vuln_logic.sink`

source statement involving `glyph_props`; do not put `glyph_props` under sink when

`data`, `control`, or `order`. `via` is the carrier expression, guard expression, or
order keyword. `relation` is optional and, when present, must be exactly
`{"op":"...","left":"...","right":"..."}`.

The `relation.op` value must be one of `eq`, `ne`, `lt`, `le`, `gt`, `ge`, or
`same_object`. Keep left/right direction meaningful for ordered relations.
`root_cause.relation` must be the missing safety condition; `sink.relation` must
be the target operation's required or violated sink predicate. Do not use
tautologies such as `{"op":"eq","left":"x","right":"x"}` or
`{"op":"same_object","left":"x","right":"x"}` to fill the field. Operands,
`via`, and relation left/right must be concrete source expressions, literals, macros,
calls, constants, or language-native variables from the cited source lines, not prose
labels or instrumentation placeholders. README.md, workspace, checkpoint files,
analysis.json, prompts, runtime logs, harness, test, and fuzz setup code are not
valid anchors for source, root_cause, sink, or propagation endpoints.

exhausted.

457	static unsigned LZ4_NbCommonBytes (reg_t val)
458	{
459	    if (LZ4_isLittleEndian()) {
460	        if (sizeof(val)==8) {
461	#       if defined(_MSC_VER) && defined(_WIN64) && !defined(LZ4_FORCE_SW_BITCOUNT)
462	            unsigned long r = 0;
463	            _BitScanForward64( &r, (U64)val );
464	            return (int)(r>>3);
465	#       elif (defined(__clang__) || (defined(__GNUC__) && (__GNUC__>=3))) && !defined(LZ4_FORCE_SW_BITCOUNT)
466	            return (unsigned)__builtin_ctzll((U64)val) >> 3;
467	#       else
468	            static const int DeBruijnBytePos[64] = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 2,
469	                                                     0, 3, 1, 3, 1, 4, 2, 7,
470	                                                     0, 2, 3, 6, 1, 5, 3, 5,
471	                                                     1, 3, 4, 4, 2, 5, 6, 7,
472	                                                     7, 0, 1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 6,
473	                                                     2, 6, 5, 5, 3, 4, 5, 6,
474	                                                     7, 1, 2, 4, 6, 4, 4, 5,
475	                                                     7, 2, 6, 5, 7, 6, 7, 7 };
476	            return DeBruijnBytePos[((U64)((val & -(long long)val) * 0x0218A392CDABBD3FULL)) >> 58];
477	#       endif
478	        } else /* 32 bits */ {
479	#       if defined(_MSC_VER) && !defined(LZ4_FORCE_SW_BITCOUNT)
480	            unsigned long r;
481	            _BitScanForward( &r, (U32)val );
482	            return (int)(r>>3);
483	#       elif (defined(__clang__) || (defined(__GNUC__) && (__GNUC__>=3))) && !defined(LZ4_FORCE_SW_BITCOUNT)
484	            return (unsigned)__builtin_ctz((U32)val) >> 3;
485	#       else
486	            static const int DeBruijnBytePos[32] = { 0, 0, 3, 0, 3, 1, 3, 0,
487	                                                     3, 2, 2, 1, 3, 2, 0, 1,
488	                                                     3, 3, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 0,
489	                                                     3, 1, 2, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1 };
490	            return DeBruijnBytePos[((U32)((val & -(S32)val) * 0x077CB531U)) >> 27];
491	#       endif
492	        }
493	    } else   /* Big Endian CPU */ {
494	        if (sizeof(val)==8) {   /* 64-bits */
495	#       if defined(_MSC_VER) && defined(_WIN64) && !defined(LZ4_FORCE_SW_BITCOUNT)
496	            unsigned long r = 0;
497	            _BitScanReverse64( &r, val );
498	            return (unsigned)(r>>3);
499	#       elif (defined(__clang__) || (defined(__GNUC__) && (__GNUC__>=3))) && !defined(LZ4_FORCE_SW_BITCOUNT)
500	            return (unsigned)__builtin_clzll((U64)val) >> 3;
501	#       else
502	            static const U32 by32 = sizeof(val)*4;  /* 32 on 64 bits (goal), 16 on 32 bits.
503	                Just to avoid some static analyzer complaining about shift by 32 on 32-bits target.
504	                Note that this code path is never triggered in 32-bits mode. */
505	            unsigned r;
506	            if (!(val>>by32)) { r=4; } else { r=0; val>>=by32; }
507	            if (!(val>>16)) { r+=2; val>>=8; } else { val>>=24; }
508	            r += (!val);
509	            return r;
510	#       endif
511	        } else /* 32 bits */ {
512	#       if defined(_MSC_VER) && !defined(LZ4_FORCE_SW_BITCOUNT)
513	            unsigned long r = 0;
514	            _BitScanReverse( &r, (unsigned long)val );
515	            return (unsigned)(r>>3);
516	#       elif (defined(__clang__) || (defined(__GNUC__) && (__GNUC__>=3))) && !defined(LZ4_FORCE_SW_BITCOUNT)
517	            return (unsigned)__builtin_clz((U32)val) >> 3;
518	#       else
519	            unsigned r;
520	            if (!(val>>16)) { r=2; val>>=8; } else { r=0; val>>=24; }
521	            r += (!val);
522	            return r;
523	#       endif
524	        }

688	static U32 LZ4_getIndexOnHash(U32 h, const void* tableBase, tableType_t tableType)
689	{
690	    LZ4_STATIC_ASSERT(LZ4_MEMORY_USAGE > 2);
691	    if (tableType == byU32) {
692	        const U32* const hashTable = (const U32*) tableBase;
693	        assert(h < (1U << (LZ4_MEMORY_USAGE-2)));
694	        return hashTable[h];
695	    }
696	    if (tableType == byU16) {
697	        const U16* const hashTable = (const U16*) tableBase;
698	        assert(h < (1U << (LZ4_MEMORY_USAGE-1)));
699	        return hashTable[h];
700	    }
701	    assert(0); return 0;  /* forbidden case */
702	}

704	static const BYTE* LZ4_getPositionOnHash(U32 h, const void* tableBase, tableType_t tableType, const BYTE* srcBase)

706	    if (tableType == byPtr) { const BYTE* const* hashTable = (const BYTE* const*) tableBase; return hashTable[h]; }
707	    if (tableType == byU32) { const U32* const hashTable = (const U32*) tableBase; return hashTable[h] + srcBase; }
708	    { const U16* const hashTable = (const U16*) tableBase; return hashTable[h] + srcBase; }   /* default, to ensure a return */
709	}

720	LZ4_FORCE_INLINE void
721	LZ4_prepareTable(LZ4_stream_t_internal* const cctx,
722	           const int inputSize,
723	           const tableType_t tableType) {
724	    /* If compression failed during the previous step, then the context
725	     * is marked as dirty, therefore, it has to be fully reset.
726	     */
727	    if (cctx->dirty) {
728	        DEBUGLOG(5, "LZ4_prepareTable: Full reset for %p", cctx);
729	        MEM_INIT(cctx, 0, sizeof(LZ4_stream_t_internal));
730	        return;
731	    }
732	
733	    /* If the table hasn't been used, it's guaranteed to be zeroed out, and is
734	     * therefore safe to use no matter what mode we're in. Otherwise, we figure
735	     * out if it's safe to leave as is or whether it needs to be reset.
736	     */
737	    if (cctx->tableType != clearedTable) {
738	        assert(inputSize >= 0);
739	        if (cctx->tableType != tableType
740	          || ((tableType == byU16) && cctx->currentOffset + (unsigned)inputSize >= 0xFFFFU)
741	          || ((tableType == byU32) && cctx->currentOffset > 1 GB)
742	          || tableType == byPtr
743	          || inputSize >= 4 KB)
744	        {
745	            DEBUGLOG(4, "LZ4_prepareTable: Resetting table in %p", cctx);
746	            MEM_INIT(cctx->hashTable, 0, LZ4_HASHTABLESIZE);
747	            cctx->currentOffset = 0;
748	            cctx->tableType = clearedTable;
749	        } else {
750	            DEBUGLOG(4, "LZ4_prepareTable: Re-use hash table (no reset)");
751	        }
752	    }
753	
754	    /* Adding a gap, so all previous entries are > LZ4_DISTANCE_MAX back, is faster
755	     * than compressing without a gap. However, compressing with
756	     * currentOffset == 0 is faster still, so we preserve that case.
757	     */
758	    if (cctx->currentOffset != 0 && tableType == byU32) {
759	        DEBUGLOG(5, "LZ4_prepareTable: adding 64KB to currentOffset");
760	        cctx->currentOffset += 64 KB;
761	    }
762	
763	    /* Finally, clear history */
764	    cctx->dictCtx = NULL;
765	    cctx->dictionary = NULL;
766	    cctx->dictSize = 0;
767	}

773	                 const char* const source,
774	                 char* const dest,
775	                 const int inputSize,
776	                 int *inputConsumed, /* only written when outputDirective == fillOutput */
777	                 const int maxOutputSize,
778	                 const limitedOutput_directive outputDirective,
779	                 const tableType_t tableType,
780	                 const dict_directive dictDirective,
781	                 const dictIssue_directive dictIssue,
782	                 const int acceleration)

787	    U32 const startIndex = cctx->currentOffset;
788	    const BYTE* base = (const BYTE*) source - startIndex;

790	
791	    const LZ4_stream_t_internal* dictCtx = (const LZ4_stream_t_internal*) cctx->dictCtx;
792	    const BYTE* const dictionary =
793	        dictDirective == usingDictCtx ? dictCtx->dictionary : cctx->dictionary;
794	    const U32 dictSize =
795	        dictDirective == usingDictCtx ? dictCtx->dictSize : cctx->dictSize;
796	    const U32 dictDelta = (dictDirective == usingDictCtx) ? startIndex - dictCtx->currentOffset : 0;   /* make indexes in dictCtx comparable with index in current context */
797	
798	    int const maybe_extMem = (dictDirective == usingExtDict) || (dictDirective == usingDictCtx);
799	    U32 const prefixIdxLimit = startIndex - dictSize;   /* used when dictDirective == dictSmall */
800	    const BYTE* const dictEnd = dictionary + dictSize;
801	    const BYTE* anchor = (const BYTE*) source;
802	    const BYTE* const iend = ip + inputSize;
803	    const BYTE* const mflimitPlusOne = iend - MFLIMIT + 1;
804	    const BYTE* const matchlimit = iend - LASTLITERALS;
805	
806	    /* the dictCtx currentOffset is indexed on the start of the dictionary,
807	     * while a dictionary in the current context precedes the currentOffset */
808	    const BYTE* dictBase = (dictDirective == usingDictCtx) ?
809	                            dictionary + dictSize - dictCtx->currentOffset :
810	                            dictionary + dictSize - startIndex;
811	
812	    BYTE* op = (BYTE*) dest;
813	    BYTE* const olimit = op + maxOutputSize;
814	
815	    U32 offset = 0;
816	    U32 forwardH;
817	
818	    DEBUGLOG(5, "LZ4_compress_generic: srcSize=%i, tableType=%u", inputSize, tableType);

820	     * as having dirty context, since no action was taken yet */

822	    if ((U32)inputSize > (U32)LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE) { return 0; }           /* Unsupported inputSize, too large (or negative) */

826	
827	    lowLimit = (const BYTE*)source - (dictDirective == withPrefix64k ? dictSize : 0);
828	
829	    /* Update context state */
830	    if (dictDirective == usingDictCtx) {
831	        /* Subsequent linked blocks can't use the dictionary. */
832	        /* Instead, they use the block we just compressed. */
833	        cctx->dictCtx = NULL;
834	        cctx->dictSize = (U32)inputSize;
835	    } else {
836	        cctx->dictSize += (U32)inputSize;
837	    }
838	    cctx->currentOffset += (U32)inputSize;
839	    cctx->tableType = (U16)tableType;
840	
841	    if (inputSize<LZ4_minLength) goto _last_literals;        /* Input too small, no compression (all literals) */
842	
843	    /* First Byte */
844	    LZ4_putPosition(ip, cctx->hashTable, tableType, base);
845	    ip++; forwardH = LZ4_hashPosition(ip, tableType);
846	
847	    /* Main Loop */
848	    for ( ; ; ) {
849	        const BYTE* match;
850	        BYTE* token;
851	
852	        /* Find a match */
853	        if (tableType == byPtr) {
854	            const BYTE* forwardIp = ip;
855	            int step = 1;
856	            int searchMatchNb = acceleration << LZ4_skipTrigger;
857	            do {
858	                U32 const h = forwardH;
859	                ip = forwardIp;
860	                forwardIp += step;
861	                step = (searchMatchNb++ >> LZ4_skipTrigger);
862	
863	                if (unlikely(forwardIp > mflimitPlusOne)) goto _last_literals;
864	                assert(ip < mflimitPlusOne);
865	
866	                match = LZ4_getPositionOnHash(h, cctx->hashTable, tableType, base);
867	                forwardH = LZ4_hashPosition(forwardIp, tableType);
868	                LZ4_putPositionOnHash(ip, h, cctx->hashTable, tableType, base);

870	            } while ( (match+LZ4_DISTANCE_MAX < ip)
871	                   || (LZ4_read32(match) != LZ4_read32(ip)) );
872	
873	        } else {   /* byU32, byU16 */
874	
875	            const BYTE* forwardIp = ip;
876	            int step = 1;
877	            int searchMatchNb = acceleration << LZ4_skipTrigger;
878	            do {
879	                U32 const h = forwardH;
880	                U32 const current = (U32)(forwardIp - base);
881	                U32 matchIndex = LZ4_getIndexOnHash(h, cctx->hashTable, tableType);
882	                assert(matchIndex <= current);
883	                assert(forwardIp - base < (ptrdiff_t)(2 GB - 1));
884	                ip = forwardIp;
885	                forwardIp += step;
886	                step = (searchMatchNb++ >> LZ4_skipTrigger);
887	
888	                if (unlikely(forwardIp > mflimitPlusOne)) goto _last_literals;
889	                assert(ip < mflimitPlusOne);
890	
891	                if (dictDirective == usingDictCtx) {
892	                    if (matchIndex < startIndex) {
893	                        /* there was no match, try the dictionary */
894	                        assert(tableType == byU32);
895	                        matchIndex = LZ4_getIndexOnHash(h, dictCtx->hashTable, byU32);
896	                        match = dictBase + matchIndex;
897	                        matchIndex += dictDelta;   /* make dictCtx index comparable with current context */
898	                        lowLimit = dictionary;
899	                    } else {
900	                        match = base + matchIndex;
901	                        lowLimit = (const BYTE*)source;
902	                    }
903	                } else if (dictDirective==usingExtDict) {
904	                    if (matchIndex < startIndex) {
905	                        DEBUGLOG(7, "extDict candidate: matchIndex=%5u  <  startIndex=%5u", matchIndex, startIndex);
906	                        assert(startIndex - matchIndex >= MINMATCH);
907	                        match = dictBase + matchIndex;
908	                        lowLimit = dictionary;
909	                    } else {
910	                        match = base + matchIndex;
911	                        lowLimit = (const BYTE*)source;
912	                    }
913	                } else {   /* single continuous memory segment */
914	                    match = base + matchIndex;
915	                }
916	                forwardH = LZ4_hashPosition(forwardIp, tableType);
917	                LZ4_putIndexOnHash(current, h, cctx->hashTable, tableType);
918	
919	                DEBUGLOG(7, "candidate at pos=%u  (offset=%u \n", matchIndex, current - matchIndex);
920	                if ((dictIssue == dictSmall) && (matchIndex < prefixIdxLimit)) { continue; }    /* match outside of valid area */

922	                if ( ((tableType != byU16) || (LZ4_DISTANCE_MAX < LZ4_DISTANCE_ABSOLUTE_MAX))

924	                    continue;
925	                } /* too far */

927	
928	                if (LZ4_read32(match) == LZ4_read32(ip)) {
929	                    if (maybe_extMem) offset = current - matchIndex;

931	                }

933	            } while(1);

936	        /* Catch up */
937	        while (((ip>anchor) & (match > lowLimit)) && (unlikely(ip[-1]==match[-1]))) { ip--; match--; }

940	        {   unsigned const litLength = (unsigned)(ip - anchor);
941	            token = op++;
942	            if ((outputDirective == limitedOutput) &&  /* Check output buffer overflow */
943	                (unlikely(op + litLength + (2 + 1 + LASTLITERALS) + (litLength/255) > olimit)) ) {

945	            }

947	                (unlikely(op + (litLength+240)/255 /* litlen */ + litLength /* literals */ + 2 /* offset */ + 1 /* token */ + MFLIMIT - MINMATCH /* min last literals so last match is <= end - MFLIMIT */ > olimit))) {
948	                op--;
949	                goto _last_literals;
950	            }
951	            if (litLength >= RUN_MASK) {
952	                int len = (int)(litLength - RUN_MASK);
953	                *token = (RUN_MASK<<ML_BITS);
954	                for(; len >= 255 ; len-=255) *op++ = 255;

956	            }
957	            else *token = (BYTE)(litLength<<ML_BITS);

959	            /* Copy Literals */
960	            LZ4_wildCopy8(op, anchor, op+litLength);

963	                        (int)(anchor-(const BYTE*)source), litLength, (int)(ip-(const BYTE*)source));

965	
966	_next_match:
967	        /* at this stage, the following variables must be correctly set :
968	         * - ip : at start of LZ operation
969	         * - match : at start of previous pattern occurence; can be within current prefix, or within extDict
970	         * - offset : if maybe_ext_memSegment==1 (constant)
971	         * - lowLimit : must be == dictionary to mean "match is within extDict"; must be == source otherwise

973	         */

976	            (op + 2 /* offset */ + 1 /* token */ + MFLIMIT - MINMATCH /* min last literals so last match is <= end - MFLIMIT */ > olimit)) {

978	            op = token;
979	            goto _last_literals;
980	        }
981	
982	        /* Encode Offset */
983	        if (maybe_extMem) {   /* static test */
984	            DEBUGLOG(6, "             with offset=%u  (ext if > %i)", offset, (int)(ip - (const BYTE*)source));
985	            assert(offset <= LZ4_DISTANCE_MAX && offset > 0);
986	            LZ4_writeLE16(op, (U16)offset); op+=2;
987	        } else  {
988	            DEBUGLOG(6, "             with offset=%u  (same segment)", (U32)(ip - match));
989	            assert(ip-match <= LZ4_DISTANCE_MAX);
990	            LZ4_writeLE16(op, (U16)(ip - match)); op+=2;
991	        }
992	
993	        /* Encode MatchLength */
994	        {   unsigned matchCode;
995	
996	            if ( (dictDirective==usingExtDict || dictDirective==usingDictCtx)
997	              && (lowLimit==dictionary) /* match within extDict */ ) {
998	                const BYTE* limit = ip + (dictEnd-match);
999	                assert(dictEnd > match);
1000	                if (limit > matchlimit) limit = matchlimit;
1001	                matchCode = LZ4_count(ip+MINMATCH, match+MINMATCH, limit);
1002	                ip += (size_t)matchCode + MINMATCH;
1003	                if (ip==limit) {
1004	                    unsigned const more = LZ4_count(limit, (const BYTE*)source, matchlimit);

1006	                    ip += more;
1007	                }

1010	                matchCode = LZ4_count(ip+MINMATCH, match+MINMATCH, matchlimit);

1059	        } else {   /* byU32, byU16 */

1061	            U32 const h = LZ4_hashPosition(ip, tableType);

1068	                    matchIndex = LZ4_getIndexOnHash(h, dictCtx->hashTable, byU32);

1071	                    matchIndex += dictDelta;
1072	                } else {
1073	                    match = base + matchIndex;
1074	                    lowLimit = (const BYTE*)source;  /* required for match length counter */
1075	                }
1076	            } else if (dictDirective==usingExtDict) {
1077	                if (matchIndex < startIndex) {
1078	                    match = dictBase + matchIndex;
1079	                    lowLimit = dictionary;   /* required for match length counter */
1080	                } else {
1081	                    match = base + matchIndex;
1082	                    lowLimit = (const BYTE*)source;   /* required for match length counter */
1083	                }
1084	            } else {   /* single memory segment */
1085	                match = base + matchIndex;
1086	            }

1090	              && (((tableType==byU16) && (LZ4_DISTANCE_MAX == LZ4_DISTANCE_ABSOLUTE_MAX)) ? 1 : (matchIndex+LZ4_DISTANCE_MAX >= current))

1092	                token=op++;
1093	                *token=0;
1094	                if (maybe_extMem) offset = current - matchIndex;
1095	                DEBUGLOG(6, "seq.start:%i, literals=%u, match.start:%i",
1096	                            (int)(anchor-(const BYTE*)source), 0, (int)(ip-(const BYTE*)source));
1097	                goto _next_match;
1098	            }
1099	        }
1100	
1101	        /* Prepare next loop */
1102	        forwardH = LZ4_hashPosition(++ip, tableType);
1103	
1104	    }
1105	
1106	_last_literals:
1107	    /* Encode Last Literals */
1108	    {   size_t lastRun = (size_t)(iend - anchor);

1110	            (op + lastRun + 1 + ((lastRun+255-RUN_MASK)/255) > olimit)) {
1111	            if (outputDirective == fillOutput) {

1119	            }
1120	        }
1121	        if (lastRun >= RUN_MASK) {
1122	            size_t accumulator = lastRun - RUN_MASK;
1123	            *op++ = RUN_MASK << ML_BITS;
1124	            for(; accumulator >= 255 ; accumulator-=255) *op++ = 255;
1125	            *op++ = (BYTE) accumulator;
1126	        } else {
1127	            *op++ = (BYTE)(lastRun<<ML_BITS);
1128	        }
1129	        memcpy(op, anchor, lastRun);
1130	        ip = anchor + lastRun;
1131	        op += lastRun;
1132	    }

1134	    if (outputDirective == fillOutput) {

1136	    }

1352	#define HASH_UNIT sizeof(reg_t)
1353	int LZ4_loadDict (LZ4_stream_t* LZ4_dict, const char* dictionary, int dictSize)
1354	{
1355	    LZ4_stream_t_internal* dict = &LZ4_dict->internal_donotuse;
1356	    const tableType_t tableType = byU32;
1357	    const BYTE* p = (const BYTE*)dictionary;
1358	    const BYTE* const dictEnd = p + dictSize;
1359	    const BYTE* base;
1360	
1361	    DEBUGLOG(4, "LZ4_loadDict (%i bytes from %p into %p)", dictSize, dictionary, LZ4_dict);
1362	
1363	    /* It's necessary to reset the context,
1364	     * and not just continue it with prepareTable()
1365	     * to avoid any risk of generating overflowing matchIndex
1366	     * when compressing using this dictionary */
1367	    LZ4_resetStream(LZ4_dict);
1368	
1369	    /* We always increment the offset by 64 KB, since, if the dict is longer,
1370	     * we truncate it to the last 64k, and if it's shorter, we still want to
1371	     * advance by a whole window length so we can provide the guarantee that
1372	     * there are only valid offsets in the window, which allows an optimization
1373	     * in LZ4_compress_fast_continue() where it uses noDictIssue even when the
1374	     * dictionary isn't a full 64k. */
1375	
1376	    if ((dictEnd - p) > 64 KB) p = dictEnd - 64 KB;
1377	    base = dictEnd - 64 KB - dict->currentOffset;
1378	    dict->dictionary = p;
1379	    dict->dictSize = (U32)(dictEnd - p);
1380	    dict->currentOffset += 64 KB;
1381	    dict->tableType = tableType;
1382	
1383	    if (dictSize < (int)HASH_UNIT) {
1384	        return 0;
1385	    }
1386	
1387	    while (p <= dictEnd-HASH_UNIT) {
1388	        LZ4_putPosition(p, dict->hashTable, tableType, base);
1389	        p+=3;
1390	    }
1391	
1392	    return (int)dict->dictSize;
1393	}

1418	static void LZ4_renormDictT(LZ4_stream_t_internal* LZ4_dict, int nextSize)
1419	{
1420	    assert(nextSize >= 0);
1421	    if (LZ4_dict->currentOffset + (unsigned)nextSize > 0x80000000) {   /* potential ptrdiff_t overflow (32-bits mode) */
1422	        /* rescale hash table */
1423	        U32 const delta = LZ4_dict->currentOffset - 64 KB;
1424	        const BYTE* dictEnd = LZ4_dict->dictionary + LZ4_dict->dictSize;
1425	        int i;
1426	        DEBUGLOG(4, "LZ4_renormDictT");
1427	        for (i=0; i<LZ4_HASH_SIZE_U32; i++) {
1428	            if (LZ4_dict->hashTable[i] < delta) LZ4_dict->hashTable[i]=0;
1429	            else LZ4_dict->hashTable[i] -= delta;
1430	        }
1431	        LZ4_dict->currentOffset = 64 KB;
1432	        if (LZ4_dict->dictSize > 64 KB) LZ4_dict->dictSize = 64 KB;
1433	        LZ4_dict->dictionary = dictEnd - LZ4_dict->dictSize;
1434	    }

1438	int LZ4_compress_fast_continue (LZ4_stream_t* LZ4_stream,
1439	                                const char* source, char* dest,
1440	                                int inputSize, int maxOutputSize,
1441	                                int acceleration)
1442	{
1443	    const tableType_t tableType = byU32;
1444	    LZ4_stream_t_internal* streamPtr = &LZ4_stream->internal_donotuse;
1445	    const BYTE* dictEnd = streamPtr->dictionary + streamPtr->dictSize;
1446	
1447	    DEBUGLOG(5, "LZ4_compress_fast_continue (inputSize=%i)", inputSize);
1448	
1449	    if (streamPtr->dirty) { return 0; } /* Uninitialized structure detected */
1450	    LZ4_renormDictT(streamPtr, inputSize);   /* avoid index overflow */
1451	    if (acceleration < 1) acceleration = ACCELERATION_DEFAULT;
1452	
1453	    /* invalidate tiny dictionaries */
1454	    if ( (streamPtr->dictSize-1 < 4-1)   /* intentional underflow */
1455	      && (dictEnd != (const BYTE*)source) ) {
1456	        DEBUGLOG(5, "LZ4_compress_fast_continue: dictSize(%u) at addr:%p is too small", streamPtr->dictSize, streamPtr->dictionary);
1457	        streamPtr->dictSize = 0;
1458	        streamPtr->dictionary = (const BYTE*)source;
1459	        dictEnd = (const BYTE*)source;
1460	    }
1461	
1462	    /* Check overlapping input/dictionary space */
1463	    {   const BYTE* sourceEnd = (const BYTE*) source + inputSize;
1464	        if ((sourceEnd > streamPtr->dictionary) && (sourceEnd < dictEnd)) {
1465	            streamPtr->dictSize = (U32)(dictEnd - sourceEnd);
1466	            if (streamPtr->dictSize > 64 KB) streamPtr->dictSize = 64 KB;
1467	            if (streamPtr->dictSize < 4) streamPtr->dictSize = 0;
1468	            streamPtr->dictionary = dictEnd - streamPtr->dictSize;
1469	        }
1470	    }
1471	
1472	    /* prefix mode : source data follows dictionary */
1473	    if (dictEnd == (const BYTE*)source) {
1474	        if ((streamPtr->dictSize < 64 KB) && (streamPtr->dictSize < streamPtr->currentOffset))
1475	            return LZ4_compress_generic(streamPtr, source, dest, inputSize, NULL, maxOutputSize, limitedOutput, tableType, withPrefix64k, dictSmall, acceleration);
1476	        else
1477	            return LZ4_compress_generic(streamPtr, source, dest, inputSize, NULL, maxOutputSize, limitedOutput, tableType, withPrefix64k, noDictIssue, acceleration);
1478	    }
1479	
1480	    /* external dictionary mode */
1481	    {   int result;
1482	        if (streamPtr->dictCtx) {
1483	            /* We depend here on the fact that dictCtx'es (produced by
1484	             * LZ4_loadDict) guarantee that their tables contain no references
1485	             * to offsets between dictCtx->currentOffset - 64 KB and
1486	             * dictCtx->currentOffset - dictCtx->dictSize. This makes it safe
1487	             * to use noDictIssue even when the dict isn't a full 64 KB.
1488	             */
1489	            if (inputSize > 4 KB) {
1490	                /* For compressing large blobs, it is faster to pay the setup
1491	                 * cost to copy the dictionary's tables into the active context,
1492	                 * so that the compression loop is only looking into one table.
1493	                 */
1494	                memcpy(streamPtr, streamPtr->dictCtx, sizeof(LZ4_stream_t));
1495	                result = LZ4_compress_generic(streamPtr, source, dest, inputSize, NULL, maxOutputSize, limitedOutput, tableType, usingExtDict, noDictIssue, acceleration);
1496	            } else {
1497	                result = LZ4_compress_generic(streamPtr, source, dest, inputSize, NULL, maxOutputSize, limitedOutput, tableType, usingDictCtx, noDictIssue, acceleration);
1498	            }
1499	        } else {
1500	            if ((streamPtr->dictSize < 64 KB) && (streamPtr->dictSize < streamPtr->currentOffset)) {
1501	                result = LZ4_compress_generic(streamPtr, source, dest, inputSize, NULL, maxOutputSize, limitedOutput, tableType, usingExtDict, dictSmall, acceleration);
1502	            } else {
1503	                result = LZ4_compress_generic(streamPtr, source, dest, inputSize, NULL, maxOutputSize, limitedOutput, tableType, usingExtDict, noDictIssue, acceleration);
1504	            }
1505	        }
1506	        streamPtr->dictionary = (const BYTE*)source;
1507	        streamPtr->dictSize = (U32)inputSize;
1508	        return result;
1509	    }
